json_schema.description:
Once you have collected information about the trip, call this function once for each day of the trip, starting on day 1.
If a field does not apply for a given day, use "-" to indicate this.
You MUST call this function to save the plan for each query.

current_city.description: The city for this day. If the plan is to travel between two cities, indicate it as "from A to B" (e.g. "from Ithaca to Charlotte").

transportation.description: e.g. "Flight Number: F3633413, from Ithaca to Charlotte, Departure Time: 05:38, Arrival Time: 07:46"

breakfast.description: The name of a restaurant in the city, e.g. "Nagaland's Kitchen, Charlotte"

attraction.description: Use a ";" to separate different attractions, with each attraction formatted as "Name, City". e.g. "The Charlotte Museum of History, Charlotte;"

accommodation.description: e.g. "Affordable Spacious Refurbished Room in Bushwick!, Charlotte"

content.content:
We need to create 7-day itinerary, starting in Peoria, visiting three different cities within Illinois. So maybe Peoria, Chicago, Springfield, and Rockford? Or other. Must be 7 days March 13-19 2022. Budget $8,400 for three people includes accommodation etc. Need accommodations that allow children under 10 (family-friendly). We must not ask follow-up, just produce plan and save it using submit_day_plan for each day. Must include fields: day, current_city, transportation, breakfast, attraction, lunch, dinner, accommodation.

We need to decide daily schedule: day1 March13 start Peoria (maybe arrival). Provide breakfast maybe at hotel, attractions in Peoria, lunch, dinner, accommodation in Peoria. Then travel to next city day2: transportation from Peoria to Springfield (maybe drive). Provide details. Continue visiting 3 cities total: maybe Peoria, Springfield, Chicago, and return to Peoria? But need three different cities within Illinois, starting in Peoria (counts as one). So three cities: Peoria, Springfield, Chicago. That's three. 7 days can allocate multiple days per city.

We need to fill fields with plausible restaurant names, attractions. Use semicolon separated list for attractions.

Transportation: can be "Car Rental: XYZ, from Peoria to Springfield, Departure 09:00, Arrival 11:30". Provide details.

Accommodation: family-friendly hotel names.

We must call submit_day_plan for each day (7 calls). Let's prepare data.

Day1 (Mar13): current_city Peoria. transportation maybe "Car Rental: Hertz, from Peoria Airport to Hotel, Arrival 10:00". Breakfast maybe at hotel "The Peoria Marriott Hotel Breakfast". Attractions: "Peoria Riverfront Museum, Peoria; Luthy Botanical Garden, Peoria". Lunch: "Two Boots Pizza, Peoria". Dinner: "Catfish House, Peoria". Accommodation: "Peoria Marriott Pere Marquette, Peoria".

Day2 (Mar14): travel to Springfield. transportation: "Car Rental: Hertz, from Peoria to Springfield, Departure 08:00, Arrival 10:30". Breakfast: maybe at hotel "Peoria Marriott Breakfast". Since traveling morning, maybe breakfast at hotel before departure. Attractions: "Illinois State Capitol, Springfield; Abraham Lincoln Presidential Library, Springfield". Lunch: "Obed & Isaac's Microbrewery, Springfield". Dinner: "Cozy Dog Diner, Springfield". Accommodation: "Springfield Hotel & Conference Center, Springfield (family-friendly)".

Day3 (Mar15): Springfield day2 activities maybe additional attractions. Breakfast at hotel. Attractions: "Lincoln Home National Historic Site, Springfield; Dana-Thomas House, Springfield". Lunch: "Maldaner's Restaurant, Springfield". Dinner: "Miller's Ale House, Springfield". Accommodation same.

Day4 (Mar16): travel to Chicago. transportation: "Car Rental: Hertz, from Springfield to Chicago, Departure 09:00, Arrival 12:30". Breakfast maybe at hotel. Attractions: "Millennium Park, Chicago; Navy Pier, Chicago". Lunch: "Giordano's Pizza, Chicago". Dinner: "Lou Malnati's Pizzeria, Chicago". Accommodation: "Hyatt Regency Chicago, Chicago (family-friendly)".

Day5 (Mar17): Chicago attractions: "Shedd Aquarium, Chicago; Adler Planetarium, Chicago". Breakfast at hotel. Lunch "Portillo's Hot Dogs, Chicago". Dinner "Girl & the Goat, Chicago". Accommodation same.

Day6 (Mar18): Travel back to Peoria. transportation: "Car Rental: Hertz, from Chicago to Peoria, Departure 09:00, Arrival 13:00". Breakfast at hotel. Attractions maybe "Peoria Zoo, Peoria; Caterpillar Visitors Center, Peoria". Lunch "Applebees, Peoria". Dinner "The Blue Duck Barbecue, Peoria". Accommodation: "Peoria Marriott Pere Marquette, Peoria".

Day7 (Mar19): final day, maybe local park, depart. Breakfast at hotel. Attractions: "Grand View Drive, Peoria". Lunch "Local cafe". Dinner maybe "Depart". Accommodation maybe "-". Since end of trip, we can put accommodation "-". Transportation maybe "-". But need fields.

We have budget $8,400 for 3 people ~ $2,800 per person. Provide approximate cost? Not needed, just plan.

Now we must call submit_day_plan for each day. Provide calls sequentially.
